spp.description: Samples per pixel accumulated per frame; the image converges over frames.

maxDepth.description: Maximum number of ray bounces of the path tracer.

aperture.description: Lens aperture of the thin-lens depth of field; 0 is a pinhole camera.

focusPlane.description: Distance of the in-focus plane from the camera, in metres.

russianRoulette.description: Terminate low-contribution paths stochastically to save work.

russianRouletteMinBounces.description: Bounces every path survives before Russian roulette may stop it.

clampIndirect.description: Clamp the peak channel of radiance contributed after the first bounce to this value to suppress fireflies; 0 disables clamping.

lightSampling.description: Debugging switch for direct lighting: 'mis' (default) combines next-event estimation with BSDF sampling using the power heuristic, 'nee' uses only explicit light sampling, 'bsdf' only light seen by BSDF rays.

exposure.description: Scales the radiance before tone mapping.

toneMapper.description: Tone mapping curve: 0 gamma 2.2, 1 sRGB, 2 ACES filmic.
